info.title: Usayd Academy — implemented API scaffold
info.description: Registered public API routes in the current refactoring stack, not a production-readiness claim. The root openapi.yaml is the separately maintained intended future contract. Arabic is the default language; machine values and error codes are stable. Web sessions require first-party CSRF cookie initialization.

post.description: Existing email-based registration scaffold; guardian/age-band consent flows are not implemented here.
Request body is optional; all_devices revokes personal access tokens, not every web session.

get.description: Use the URL returned by the server without altering its signed parameters.
